# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** 15 years old  <sub>[v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is fair with gentle, mild hazel eyes and a straight nose. She has long, sleek curls that never get out of order and a 'prunes and prisms' mouth. She always looks neat, starched, and proper.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is quiet, good, prim, and exceptionally well-behaved. She is industrious, neat, and systematic in her work and duties, taking pleasure in helping around the household. Very composed, placid, and careful, she is seldom ruffled by dramatic events. However, her predictable and demure behavior causes some to regard her as somewhat monotonous.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v4 c4 P5](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0005)_

## History

After their mother's death, seven-year-old Dora and her twin brother Davy were brought to Green Gables to live with Marilla Cuthbert. At Green Gables, Dora quickly gained a reputation for being quiet, neat, and obedient, assisting Marilla with various chores around the house. When school opened, she began attending alongside Davy and settled into her studies as a quiet student. She maintained her calm demeanor through severe storms and domestic changes alike, such as Anne Shirley's departures for college and eventual marriage. By the age of fifteen, Dora was set to inherit Anne's former porch room at Green Gables.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)_
